newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Companion Marble shrs suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Companion Marble shrs suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of marble and granite products distributor Companion Marble (Holdings) Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an annnouncement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Monday.
Companion Marble, a spinoff of construction materials concern Companion Building Material (Holdings) Ltd, was listed on the Stock Exchange on April 25, 1996.
The company shares ended HK$0.02 down at HK$1.09 per share on Friday.
It posted an interim profit of HK$32.24 million for six months to September 30, up 31 percent from the same period a year ago.
